title: Org Safety Configurator: IP allowlist, SSO enforcement & audit export controls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an "org-level safety configurator" that exposes guarded admin toggles for compliance-sensitive controls: IP allowlisting for control-plane/API access, a strict SSO/SAML enforcement toggle to prevent non-SSO logins, and data export/public-sharing restrictions with audit/export controls. The feature must integrate with RBAC v2 so only authorized admin roles can change toggles; all toggle changes and enforcement events must be recorded in structured audit logs with export hooks. This work covers backend APIs, console UX, RBAC bindings, audit schema, and migration strategy for existing orgs.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Org-level toggles created in DB and accessible via admin API (GET/PUT) with RBAC v2 checks.
2) IP allowlist enforces control-plane requests (console/API) when enabled; admin APIs return 403 for out-of-range IPs with clear error codes.
3) SSO enforcement prevents new non-SSO user sessions; existing users without SSO should be flagged and admins notified.
4) Data export/public-sharing toggle blocks UI/API actions (export CSV, public link creation) and surfaces a standard error message.
5) Every toggle mutation and enforcement action emits structured audit events (actor, org, toggle, before, after, reason, request_id, ip, timestamp) to the audit pipeline and is queryable from the console audit view.
6) Admin console surfaces toggle state, last changed by, last changed at, and optional justification field for compliance audits.
7) Migration script for orgs with pre-existing ad-hoc settings maps to new toggles without data loss and logs migration audit events.
8) E2E tests cover API, RBAC gating, enforcement paths, and audit emission. Performance regression on API latency is <5%.

risk_mitigation:
- Roll out behind feature flag and restrict access to a pilot org set.
- Add canary enforcement window to monitor false positives (2 weeks) and automatic rollback if >0.5% legitimate requests blocked.
- Provide 'dry-run' audit mode that emits enforcement events but does not block requests for the first pilot phase.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge behind FF and enable for internal orgs. 2) Pilot with two compliance customers (enable dry-run then blocking). 3) Monitor audit stream & customer SLOs for 2 weeks. 4) Gradual enablement for enterprise orgs with signed addendum. 5) Full on-by-default for new orgs in security-2026.03 release.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for API and RBAC gate logic.
- Integration tests simulating IPs inside/outside allowlist for console and API.
- E2E flow that creates toggle change via console, validates audit event, and ensures enforcement blocks actions.
- Load test to confirm audit emission at peak (10k events/min) without backpressure.
- Security fuzzing for SAML assertion handling when enforcement is enabled.
